validity_findings.finding: Frozen spec P1_UNSEEN 99,100,101 violates endpoint existence: jsonplaceholder.typicode.com has posts 1-100 (101 404) and users 1-10 (99-101 all 404). Per audit live probe: posts/99 200, posts/100 200, posts/101 404; users/99 404, users/100 404, users/101 404; comments?postId=99 200 non-empty, ?postId=100 200 non-empty, ?postId=101 200 [] empty. Therefore maximum achievable http_correct is 2/3 posts +0/3 users +3/3 comments =5/9 (0.556) even with perfect binding, making decision_rule condition 1 (9/9 >=1.0) and condition 3 (B_LITERAL 9/9) mathematically impossible. Producer correctly diagnoses 'test design flaw' and observations show url_accuracy 1.0 (9/9) vs http_accuracy 0.333 (3/9) (audit correct 5/9) but frozen FALSIFIED is artifact, not binding falsification.

validity_findings.impact: Condition 1 and 3 FALSIFIES triggers do not falsify hypothesis 'parameterized mechanisms bind correctly over real HTTP'. Binding correctness is demonstrated at URL construction level (1.0) and would be 5/9 with correct validation; literal baseline identical 3/9 (5/9 corrected) confirms failure source is API data limits not parameterization. Measurement invalid for 9/9 gate; claim ceiling must exclude HTTP 9/9 success.

validity_findings.finding: Producer body_valid logic for fetch_comments incorrectly rejects non-empty valid lists: code checks if isinstance(body_json, dict) then fetch_comments dict keys, else if isinstance(body_json, list) and len==0 True. Since jsonplaceholder returns list of comments, non-empty lists never satisfy dict branch and len==0 is false, so body_valid stays False. Result: fetch_comments http_correct 1/3 (only postId=101 empty list) instead of correct 3/3 (all postIds 99,100 return valid non-empty lists; 101 returns [] valid). Audit recompute with correct list-of-dicts validation gives fetch_comments 3/3, posts 2/3, users 0/3 => 5/9 overall; producer undercounts by 2.

Does not change decision outcome (still <1.0) but is systematic measurement error that understates HTTP correctness and must be fixed before any claim about comment endpoint.

claim_ceiling: URL construction correctness SURVIVES: distill_parameterized (src/spider/kernel.py Fix1+Fix2+Fix3, sha30b741...) induces 3 GET-only mechanisms (fetch_posts GET template https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/${url} for mixed GET+PUT training, fetch_users https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users/${url}, fetch_comments https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/comments?postId=${url}) with slot_prefixes ''/''/'comments?postId=' and string-match binding_accuracy 1.0 (9/9 unseen IDs 99,100,101). Real HTTP binding correctness is MEASUREMENT_INVALID for the frozen 9/9 gate: maximum achievable on jsonplaceholder is 5/9 (posts 2/3, users 0/3, comments 3/3 with correct validation; producer undercounts 3/9 due to comment list bug) because users 99-101 and posts 101 do not exist (API: 100 posts, 10 users) — literal baseline shows identical 3/9 (5/9 corrected) failures, confirming API limits not parameterization. Fix3 protocol-only rejection holds (returns None for truly protocol-only), token heuristic 62.5 vs 110.25 cheaper but not actual tokenization, kernel regression 3/3 PASS, GET-only scope. Does NOT establish: HTTP 9/9 success, actual token economics, method-preserving reduction, live traffic prevalence. C-PARAM-INHERIT remains EXPERIMENTAL at synthetic single-slot GET URL correctness; C-PRODUCT-ECON remains HYPOTHESIS pending valid-ID real HTTP and actual tokenizer pricing.
